thermal_runs.scope: Actually trained hierarchical channel on exact four-site periodic Ising Gibbs states at beta=1. Learned ZZ-observable retention; finite-size states, not an infinite-system phase-transition claim. Effective H=-log rho is exact; Ising-family truncation error is measured.

infinite_width.feature: sqrt(2) times Z expectation after RY(w dot x + phase); w iid standard normal, phase uniform [0,2pi)
infinite_width.width: Number of independent single-qubit feature circuits, not a covering degree or simultaneous qubit count
infinite_width.theorem: K_M converges to exp(-||x-y||²/2). On n fixed inputs, P(max error>epsilon)<=2 n² exp(-M epsilon²/8). Readout-only kernel training is a distinct regime from training all quantum gates.

width_controls.scope: Nested prefixes of the same independent feature sequence. Fully shared parameters do not supply independent width; their rank-one kernel is unchanged by repetition.

gate_learning_baselines.selection: Frozen initialization determined by the same public seed. Only its scalar readout is fitted on training couplings; test couplings do not select it.
gate_learning_baselines.oracle_scope: The full input density matrix and declared ZZ observable determine the target exactly. This is an analytic oracle, not an equally compressed learned representation.
